### Prerequisites

- [X] I verified that this is not an existing issue
- [X] This is not a question, poll, or discussion
- [X] I checked the documentation to understand that the issue I report is not a normal behavior

### Description

Along side hosting hosts (RFC:954) blacklists, you should be hosting a "Clean" alternative, for easier import for the majority. who do not rely on ~60 years old technology, but have moved on to more modern approaches like RPZ- and firewalls. It will in general, be easier to import by any program, as it won't need a cleaning process first.

A clean list, is a lists that only contains the domains, no comment, no prefix, domains only
